hidden_test_cmd: sh -c 'PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" exec python -m pytest -q -p no:subtests "$@"' sh tests/hidden
tests_may_change_note: New cases go into existing test methods in sqlglot, so every dialect test file and the tokenizer, parser and transpile tests are allowed.

replay.reference_note: the fix's whole diff, tests included
replay.hidden_tests_from: the round-trip half of the fix's TestSnowflake::test_stage_path_tokenization; its token-type, position and line/column assertions are left out because they name the fix's own token types

naive_patches.naive.patch: the fix, except that a path still stops where /* starts, so @s/a/*b and @s/a/*b*/c are cut off
